To start this new year, we as true believers and servants of Allah need to take to account ever deed and action we have committed knowingly and unknowingly whether it be to ourselves, family members, friends or people we either know or don't know. Allah has mercy upon those who truly believe, repents, sticks to being righteously guided and forfill our every righteous deed and brings peace into our hearts and homes. I pray that we all find that peace we seek for and that Allah reunites all our families and rebuild those special bonds we once had before while growing up. Don't let wealth and the distractions of this world break apart your family bonds. Seal the cracks before Allah takes away someone that was once dear to us. ✨️🤲✨️💞😇
